content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Podia promise simplicity but fail in restricted regions. They lock you into their payment processors, which Kenya-based creators can’t use. Crypto-native solutions often require technical expertise or force you into their ecosystems. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) delivers a different architecture: a fully deployable commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. The tradeoff? You handle deployment. The reward? Lifetime infrastructure sovereignty. Compare this to renting a Shopify store or relying on a crypto gateway that could change terms overnight. The Builder Kit isn’t a tool—it’s a blueprint for ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal block Kenya outright due to regulatory or risk assessments. Even crypto-friendly solutions often require KYC, which defeats the purpose of decentralized commerce. COREMERCH’s stacks bypass this by leveraging decentralized hosting (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages) and payment verification (NOWPayments). Transactions occur on-chain, with no buyer account required. The system doesn’t care where you’re located—it only verifies payment. This architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and other financially isolated regions. Compare this to platforms that claim "global reach" but fail in Kenya. The Builder Kit doesn’t workaround restrictions—it ignores them by design.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, plus currency conversion fees. Crypto payment gateways often add 1-3% on top of network fees. COREMERCH’s stacks use NOWPayments, which charges a flat 0.5% fee. Transactions on BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes, triggering automatic product delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. The real cost? $197 for the Builder Kit, then lifetime ownership. Compare this to monthly subscriptions or per-transaction fees that compound. The tradeoff is clear: pay once for infrastructure you own, or rent tools that extract value indefinitely.
Sovereign commerce isn’t a feature—it’s a necessity for creators in restricted regions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms like Gumroad or Kajabi own your customer data, your product delivery logic, and your payment flow. If they shut down or change terms, you’re stranded. COREMERCH’s stacks deploy to your own GitHub or Cloudflare accounts. Order data lives in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation runs on your backend logic. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. You own the entire stack. The tradeoff? You’re responsible for maintenance. The reward? No platform can shut you down. This architecture isn’t just sovereign—it’s future-proof.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re selling a single product and need zero technical setup, conventional platforms might suffice—if they’re available in Kenya. If you’re building a long-term digital business, renting infrastructure is a liability. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit is for creators who want ownership, not workarounds. It’s for those who understand that sovereign commerce isn’t a feature—it’s a necessity. If you’re in Kenya, Ghana, or Zimbabwe, this isn’t an upgrade. It’s the only architecture that works. The choice is clear: rent tools and hope they don’t fail, or deploy infrastructure you own.

To start selling digital products with crypto in Kenya, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Avoid platforms that lock you into their payment systems or require KYC. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees. Own your infrastructure—don’t rent it. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit provides the blueprints and templates to deploy this architecture in 48 hours.
Owning your infrastructure means no platform can shut you down or change terms overnight.

Ready to deploy your own sovereign commerce stack? COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and instant access to the tools you need to sell globally without platform restrictions. No subscriptions. No hidden fees. Just infrastructure you own.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free, decentralized deployment. 2. Set up backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing and automation. 3. Configure payment processing: Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto verification with a 0.5% fee. 4. Store order data: Use Supabase or Google Sheets for secure, owned databases. 5. Deliver products: Host files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant, automated delivery. 6. Test end-to-end: Ensure payment confirmation triggers file delivery seamlessly. 7. Deploy and own: Push your stack live—no platform dependencies, no recurring costs.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built templates and step-by-step blueprints. Deployment requires basic technical understanding, but no coding expertise.
What if NOWPayments changes its terms?
NOWPayments is just one component. The stack is designed to swap payment processors without disrupting your infrastructure. You own the integration logic.
How do I handle customer support for crypto payments?
Provide clear instructions for recommended networks (BSC, Solana, TRON) and include a transaction confirmation guide. Most issues resolve with proper documentation.
Can I scale this architecture as my business grows?
Yes. The Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook. Add more products, expand delivery channels, or integrate additional payment processors as needed.
What happens if GitHub or Cloudflare shuts down my account?
While rare, deploy redundantly across both platforms. The Builder Kit includes instructions for multi-platform deployment to ensure continuity.
